This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，The original repeats the time meaning because 古代 already refers to a historical time period. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看：看到，The sentence means that Shennong saw people eating plants, so the perception result needs 看到 rather than 看. [rule: resultative_complement]
3. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 一：delete 一，An immediate sequence beginning with 一V needs a following 就 clause. Since this sentence only states that Shennong saw something, use the direct perception verb 看到 instead. [teacher rule: yi_jiu]
